name: daimonos
description: Agent-optimized MCP server with structured JSON tools. 20-45% token savings.
long_description: Daimonos replaces built-in file, search, exec, and git tools with structured equivalents that return compact JSON instead of raw terminal output. Native plugins for git, cargo, gh, and docker. Semantic output filtering, read deduplication, batch operations, workspace snapshots, and token analytics.

workspace.title: Workspace Directory
workspace.description: Root directory of the project to work in

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read file with optional offset/limit and content-hash deduplication

tools.name: search
tools.description: Regex search (content mode) or file discovery (file mode)

tools.name: exec
tools.description: Run commands with semantic output filtering

tools.name: batch
tools.description: Multiple operations in a single round-trip

tools.name: workspace_info
tools.description: Project type, git status, directory listing, analytics

tools.name: git
tools.description: Structured git operations: status, log, diff, branch, add, commit, push, pull, checkout

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Workspace checkpoint and rollback: create, restore, list, delete

tools.name: session_stats
tools.description: Token analytics: session, history, or daily scope
